title: AI-DWG Data
description: Per-project data shape for AI-DWG (Workspace Generator). DWG has no state file; data reflects the generated workspace identity.

aiLens.description: AI-LENS fields (AI_LENS_PROTOCOL §6.2 — AI-DWG contract). Present when the workspace was generated for a project with AI features.

aiFeaturesCouriered.description: Count of AI features couriered into this workspace

aiScaffoldingGenerated.description: Whether AI-specific scaffolding (deps, config, eval harness) was generated

aiContextCouriered.description: Whether the full AI-feature context (AC, architecture, EU-AI-Act) was couriered for AIG__/AIQ__

automationLens.description: Automation-LENS fields (AUTOMATION_LENS_PROTOCOL §6.2 — AI-DWG contract). Present when the workspace was generated for a project with automated features.

automationFeaturesCouriered.description: Count of automation features couriered into this workspace

automationScaffoldingGenerated.description: Whether automation-specific scaffolding (engine config, scheduler, queue, connector stubs) was generated

automationContextCouriered.description: Whether the full automation-feature context (AC, architecture, control-class) was couriered for ATG__/ATQ__
